highFidelityFeatures.camera: 360-degree horizontal orbit with near-180-degree vertical travel

resourceTiers.label: STAGE 1 FOREST LAUNCH — 1 GB PLAN
resourceTiers.description: The first staged release targets a 1 GiB source budget. Only measured authored launch-slice bytes are published; the remaining budget is future real content, never padding.

resourceTiers.label: HIGH-END RESOURCES — NOT PUBLISHED
resourceTiers.description: No signed cooked world sectors, characters, maps, models, textures, shaders, or archive payload is published for this APK. The 6,750 MiB figure is a packaging plan, not an installed or downloadable size.
